children: Yadav brings over two decades of experience across HR leadership, talent strategy and organisational transformation

Suman Yadav has been appointed Chief Human Resources Officer at Wakefit, effective 1 October 2026. She brings more than 25 years of experience across human resources leadership, people strategy, talent management and organisational transformation.

Yadav joins Wakefit after serving as Strategic Advisor at NeonRay and previously as Director, Human Resources at Amazon. Her career also includes a senior HR role at Infosys BPM and five years of service as a Captain in the Indian Army.
Yadav spent more than 12 years at Amazon, where she served as Director, Human Resources from January 2013 to September 2025.

During her tenure, she led people strategy for a portfolio spanning India Technology and broader business teams. She was involved in scaling Amazon’s technology organisation in India from 150 to more than 5,000 employees.

Her responsibilities included organisational design, leadership development, performance management and succession planning. She also led global university hiring across more than 40 countries and worked on early-career talent programmes.
Before joining Wakefit, Yadav served as Strategic Advisor at NeonRay from October 2025. Her work focused on people strategy, organisational design, talent architecture and workforce planning.
She also describes her work as an HR domain expert for an AI development initiative, where she evaluates enterprise HR applications including recruitment, succession, pay equity and compliance.

Yadav began her corporate HR career at Infosys BPM, where she served as Senior Lead Business Partner HR from August 2009 to January 2013. She worked on HR strategy for the BFSI vertical across multiple locations, covering performance, compensation, engagement and compliance.
Earlier, she served in the Indian Army as a Captain from September 1998 to April 2004. Her responsibilities included logistics, resource planning and personnel operations.
At Wakefit, Yadav takes charge of the company’s human resources function after building experience across technology, e-commerce and business services.
Her appointment adds an HR leader with experience spanning workforce planning, leadership development, talent management and organisational design to the company’s leadership team.
Yadav holds an Executive Programme in Business Management and HRM from the Indian Institute of Management Bangalore and a BSc in Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics from Maharshi Dayanand University.
